description: File an item into a folder. target_id is the thing being filed (a generation id by default; set item_type for CAMPAIGN_ENTITY, DOCUMENT, SESSION, IMAGE or VIDEO_PROJECT). When filing CAMPAIGN_ENTITY, DOCUMENT, SESSION or VIDEO_PROJECT into a codex folder that a campaign references, campaign_id is REQUIRED - the item lands in that campaign's overlay, not the codex itself. IMAGE items can only be filed into campaign workspace folders and Atlas places (folders with place=true), never other codex folders, and only your own pictures: another member's picture, public or not, is not_found. Filing the same target twice updates the existing row: an omitted note clears it, an omitted pinned value unpins it, and an omitted sort_order keeps the current position.

campaign_id.description: Required when filing CAMPAIGN_ENTITY/DOCUMENT/SESSION/VIDEO_PROJECT into a codex folder the campaign references (routes into that campaign's overlay)

note.description: Optional note on the filed item

pinned.description: Pin the item to the top of the folder

sort_order.description: Optional sort position within the folder (lower sorts first)

target_id.description: UUID of the item to file (generation, campaign entity, document, session, image or completed film)

name: chargen_add_collection_item
title: File item in folder
